issues.title: Curated main is not a faithful V551 runtime baseline
issues.affected: GitHub main @ a819fb3 vs Desktop/runtime lineage e2afe02→9838527
issues.defect: Curated main contains an older/different V551 projection implementation, including the fabricated 1.0 fallback for missing positive/negative intensity, while the Desktop/runtime lineage blocks unresolved projection instead. Treating main file-for-file as semantic source truth would reintroduce a known defect.
issues.evidence: main ddm_v551_atoms.py SHA 4246628a…; runtime SHA 6929cdcf…; main lines around direct signed projection use `else 1.0`; runtime does not.
issues.consequence: A naive main-based repair can regress already-fixed runtime behavior.
issues.required: Branch from main for clean Git history, but reconcile touched V550–V552J files against the runtime lineage and accepted checkpoints. Never wholesale copy main V551 semantics over runtime.
tests: Regression: positive/negative missing raw intensity must never become 1.0.
Diff report must classify every touched main/runtime delta.

issues.title: Canonical V551 scale registry and manifest are absent from curated main
issues.defect: The governed 35-wave scale registry and its manifest are required runtime authority for accepted V551 scale projection, but the curated main transfer does not contain them.
issues.evidence: Registry SHA d270f59d…fc8; manifest SHA 5e25ae39…990. The accepted V551 loader hard-blocks missing files and validates manifest schema/hash.
issues.consequence: Main cannot reproduce the accepted scale-v5 projection contract without restoring exact governed bytes.
issues.required: Install the exact registry and manifest in the mainline source boundary; verify exact SHA-256 before use. Do not regenerate or substitute.
tests: Exact file SHA matches pinned values.

issues.title: Runtime V551 added an authority-by-response-family fallback not present in accepted v5
issues.defect: The August runtime file differs from the accepted v5 file by one 15-line block that, when exact response_semantics_contract_hash lookup fails, searches registry rows by response_family and accepts a unique DIRECTIONAL_MAGNITUDE rule. This weakens exact authority identity.
issues.evidence: Accepted V551 SHA 1339fb91…; runtime SHA 6929cdcf…. Unified diff shows only the response-family fallback block at runtime around line 1186.
issues.consequence: A missing/incorrect contract hash can be masked by family similarity, violating the accepted rule that missing registry geometry/identity must not be inferred at runtime.
issues.required: Remove the family fallback from canonical V551 adjudication. Exact contract-hash authority only, unless a future explicit governed alias registry is created.
tests: Unknown contract hash + known response family must remain blocked.
